abstract: A 20-year-old man was admitted to our hospital with persistent cough and dyspnea. He had bilateral distention of the jugular veins, and swollen lymph nodes were palpable in the right subclavicular region. Plain X-ray and computed tomography (CT) of the chest showed a solid soft tissue mass in the upper mediastinum, with leftward displacement of the trachea and complete obstruction of the superior vena cava. Mediastinal radiotherapy (1.8 Gy/day) and methylprednisolone (100 mg/day) were started immediately. Biopsy of the right subclavicular lymph nodes revealed metastatic seminoma. The patient was referred for chemotherapy, which was performed with a combination of cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide (BEP). A partial response was observed after completion of 3 cycles of chemotherapy, but there was no further tumor shrinkage after additional salvage chemotherapy. The patient is being followed up on an outpatient basis and has been free of recurrence for 32 months after intensive treatment.
abstract_ja: 20歳男性が、持続する咳嗽と呼吸困難で当院を受診した。両側頸静脈の怒張があり、右鎖骨下領域に腫大したリンパ節が触知された。胸部単純X線および胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、上縦隔の充実性軟部組織腫瘤、気管の左方偏位、上大静脈の完全閉塞が認められた。直ちに縦隔放射線療法(1.8 Gy/日)とメチルプレドニゾロン(100 mg/日)を開始した。右鎖骨下リンパ節の生検で転移性セミノーマと判明した。シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによるBEP療法を行った。3コース終了後に部分奏効が得られたが、追加の救援化学療法を行っても腫瘍のさらなる縮小は認められなかった。集中的治療後32か月間、外来で経過観察しており、再発はない。
